pages.title: The Teapot
pages.text: The pot takes one tea bag at a time. Pour in water or milk, brew for 240 seconds, and you get 12 cups.$(br2)Catch them in an empty cup from the kitchen, then hold the cup and use it.
The teapot comes from Kaleidoscope Cookery. Its recipe is not one this book can draw - only the 7 vanilla recipe types can be. Look it up in JEI under kaleidoscope_cookery:teapot.
